packs.name: adr-status
packs.description: Appends a dated status update to a decision record when a later session reversed, replaced or revisited the decision.

packs.name: api-drift
packs.description: Appends documented endpoints, fields or status codes that session turns contradict, quoting the turn.

packs.name: changelog-keeper
packs.description: Appends the user-visible changes sessions shipped to a changelog note, under a final Pending section.

packs.name: decision-log
packs.description: Appends the decisions sessions made, with the reason and the rejected options, to a decision log note.

packs.name: dependency-changes
packs.description: Appends the packages sessions added, removed or upgraded, with versions and the reason, to a dependencies note.

packs.name: deploy-log
packs.description: Appends the deploys sessions ran or watched, with what, where, when and outcome, to a deploy log note.

packs.name: env-and-config
packs.description: Appends the variables, flags and settings sessions introduced, renamed or removed, by name and never by value, to an environment note.

packs.name: error-catalogue
packs.description: Appends the error messages sessions hit and the fix that worked to an errors or troubleshooting note.

packs.name: faq
packs.description: Appends questions users asked in sessions and the answer the session established to a FAQ note.

packs.name: glossary-terms
packs.description: Appends terms sessions defined or used in a fixed sense that the glossary lacks.

packs.name: gotchas
packs.description: Appends surprising behaviour that cost a session time and is not an error to a gotchas or pitfalls note.

packs.name: high-contrast
packs.description: Text and controls at a contrast of at least 7:1.

packs.name: incident-timeline
packs.description: Appends timeline entries from sessions that worked on an incident.

packs.name: large-type
packs.description: A larger base size and line height for reading.

packs.name: limits-and-quotas
packs.description: Appends rate limits, quotas and usage caps that sessions ran into to a limits or quotas note, quoting the error.

packs.name: measurements
packs.description: Appends new measured values from tool output, with the date and conditions, to a benchmarks or measurements note.

packs.name: migration-log
packs.description: Appends each database migration a session ran, with its environment and outcome, to a migrations note.

packs.name: onboarding-gaps
packs.description: Appends setup facts sessions had to discover: commands, variable names, ports and accounts.

packs.name: open-questions
packs.description: Appends questions sessions raised and left open, and answers to questions the note lists.

packs.name: paper
packs.description: A warm, low-glare light scheme.

packs.name: related-links
packs.description: Appends Related lines linking notes that a session's handoff connects but that do not link each other.

packs.name: runbook-check
packs.description: Appends runbook steps that failed, were skipped or needed another command when a session followed the runbook.

packs.name: schema-notes
packs.description: Appends tables, columns and fields that sessions added, renamed or dropped to a schema or data model note.

packs.name: security-log
packs.description: Appends security-relevant changes sessions made (auth, permissions, secret handling, advisories) to a security note, never secrets.

packs.name: test-commands
packs.description: Appends the build, test and lint commands sessions ran successfully, which the note lacks, to a testing or build note.

packs.name: todo-done
packs.description: Appends Done lines for listed tasks that sessions completed to a TODO, tasks or backlog note, and never adds tasks.
